## What this document does

Checks the needle/root/mycorrhiza litter nitrogen mechanism added
2026-11-05 (`actual_growth.cpp`, `sugar_model.cpp`'s two `nitrogen_balance`
update sites): (1) the nitrogen actually lost via each litter pathway,
net of retranslocation, and (2) the effect of crediting the resorbed
fraction back to `nitrogen_balance`, by comparing against the same run
with all three `retrans_*` parameters set to 0 (i.e. no resorption - all
litter N lost, the pre-2026-11-05 behaviour).

```{r libraries}
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)

pub_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom")
```

```{r setup-data}
data_directory  <- "~/Documents/CASSIA_Calibration/Processed_Data/"
loaded_data     <- load_data(data_directory)

new_parameters  <- rep(0.5, 27)
parameters_2015 <- initialize_parameters(calibration = FALSE, new_parameters)
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("h0"),          "Hyde"] <- 12
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("D0"),          "Hyde"] <- 0.1646
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("GPP_mean"),    "Hyde"] <- 463.8833
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("GPP_initial"), "Hyde"] <- 460.0

weather_preles <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_preles.csv")
weather_1998_2022 <- weather_preles[
  weather_preles$date >= as.Date("1998-01-01") &
  weather_preles$date <= as.Date("2022-12-31"), ]
weather_1998_2022$dates <- as.Date(weather_1998_2022$date)
dates_1998_2022 <- weather_1998_2022$dates
```

```{r run-model}
# retrans_needles/retrans_roots/retrans_myco moved into parameters_p
# 2026-11-09 (no longer standalone CASSIA_cpp() arguments) - set them on a
# copy of parameters_2015$parameters_test's Hyde column instead.
run_with_retrans <- function(retrans_needles_val, retrans_roots_val, retrans_myco_val) {
  parameters_run <- parameters_2015$parameters_test
  parameters_run["retrans_needles", "Hyde"] <- retrans_needles_val
  parameters_run["retrans_roots",   "Hyde"] <- retrans_roots_val
  parameters_run["retrans_myco",    "Hyde"] <- retrans_myco_val

  CASSIA_cpp(
    weather                    = weather_1998_2022, site = "Hyde",
    pPREL                      = c(parameters_2015$pPREL, parameters_2015$N_parameters),
    parameters                 = parameters_run,
    common                     = common_p, ratios = ratios_p,
    sperling                   = parameters_2015$sperling_test,
    needle_mass_in             = 0, Throughfall = parameters_2015$Throughfall,
    photosynthesis_as_input    = FALSE, nitrogen_balance = 25, nitrogen_change = TRUE,
    preles                     = TRUE, fAPAR_Tian = TRUE, organ_level_sugar = FALSE,
    needle_mass_grows          = TRUE, height_diameter_correction = TRUE,
    leaf_mass_correction       = TRUE, root_turnover = TRUE
  )
}

CASSIA_with    <- run_with_retrans(0.73, 0.2, 0.0)  # defaults
CASSIA_without <- run_with_retrans(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)   # pre-2026-11-05 behaviour
```

## Nitrogen content of litter, 1998--2022

```{r litter-N-totals}
N_df <- data.frame(
  dates   = dates_1998_2022,
  year    = as.integer(format(dates_1998_2022, "%Y")),
  needle  = CASSIA_with$Turnover$needle_litter_N,
  root    = CASSIA_with$Turnover$root_litter_N,
  myco    = CASSIA_with$Turnover$mycorrhiza_litter_N
)

N_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(dates = N_df$dates, value = cumsum(N_df$needle), Organ = "Needles"),
  data.frame(dates = N_df$dates, value = cumsum(N_df$root),   Organ = "Roots"),
  data.frame(dates = N_df$dates, value = cumsum(N_df$myco),   Organ = "Mycorrhiza")
)
```

```{r cumulative-litter-N, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5}
ggplot(N_long, aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = Organ)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Needles" = "#1b7837", "Roots" = "#762a83", "Mycorrhiza" = "#e08214")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative nitrogen lost via litter, net of retranslocation",
       subtitle = "1998-2022, Hyde-initialised; retrans_needles=0.73, retrans_roots=0.2, retrans_myco=0",
       x = NULL, y = "Cumulative N (mg)") +
  pub_theme
```

## Effect of the retranslocation credit on nitrogen\_balance

```{r balance-comparison}
balance_df <- data.frame(
  dates        = dates_1998_2022,
  with_retrans = CASSIA_with$Sugar$nitrogen_balance,
  no_retrans   = CASSIA_without$Sugar$nitrogen_balance
)
balance_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(dates = balance_df$dates, value = balance_df$with_retrans, Scenario = "With retranslocation (defaults)"),
  data.frame(dates = balance_df$dates, value = balance_df$no_retrans,   Scenario = "Without (retrans_* = 0)")
)
```

```{r balance-comparison-plot, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5}
ggplot(balance_long, aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("With retranslocation (defaults)" = "#1b7837",
                                  "Without (retrans_* = 0)" = "#762a83")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "nitrogen_balance: with vs. without the retranslocation credit",
       x = NULL, y = "nitrogen_balance") +
  pub_theme
```

```{r summary-numbers}
cat("Total N lost to litter, net of retranslocation, 1998-2022 (mg):\n")
cat("  needles:", round(sum(N_df$needle), 1), "\n")
cat("  roots:  ", round(sum(N_df$root), 1), "\n")
cat("  myco:   ", round(sum(N_df$myco), 1), "\n")
cat("\nFinal nitrogen_balance, with vs without retranslocation:\n")
cat("  with:   ", round(tail(balance_df$with_retrans, 1), 3), "\n")
cat("  without:", round(tail(balance_df$no_retrans, 1), 3), "\n")
```
